articles.title: Tanya lecture/video: The Holy Epistle
articles.summary: This article, a class on 'Tanya/Iggeres HaKodesh - The Holy Epistle, Epistle 21', analyzes the rationale for managing annual financial pledges. It explains the reasons for dividing yearly commitments into smaller, consistent weekly or monthly payments. This guidance likely aims to facilitate regular charitable giving and adherence to religious obligations, providing practical insights into spiritual financial discipline for aspirants.

articles.title: Gurugram sessions court grants a 7-day remand to Punjab Minister Sanjeev Arora
articles.summary: Punjab Minister Sanjeev Arora has been granted a seven-day remand to the Enforcement Directorate (ED) by the Gurugram sessions court. The ED, after presenting Arora, had sought a 10-day remand for further investigation. This development involves a prominent political figure and signifies ongoing legal proceedings within the country concerning accountability.

articles.title: Fast Patrol Vessel ‘Achal’ commissioned into Coast Guard
articles.summary: The Fast Patrol Vessel (FPV) Achal was commissioned into the Indian Coast Guard on May 9, significantly enhancing its operational capabilities. This addition strengthens India's maritime security, crucial for coastal surveillance and protection. As the fifth vessel of its class, Achal bolsters the Coast Guard's fleet, improving its responsiveness in patrolling and search and rescue operations, vital for an SSB aspirant to understand India's defence preparedness.

articles.title: Putin chides NATO in speech at scaled-back Victory Day parade
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin recently declared that his soldiers in Ukraine are fighting an "aggressive force" backed by NATO, while simultaneously asserting the "justice" of Russia's war goals. This statement frames the ongoing conflict as a defensive struggle against Western influence, reiterating Russia's strategic justifications amidst international pressure.
